meta.description: Every item that stores energy (and a few that do not), at several energy levels.
meta.fields: item; handler (the item has an energy handler: capacity, and charge/discharge by one manual insert and extract of 2^31-1 into a full and an empty stack); default_has_component (the default components of the item hold mekanism:energy); one line per level: level (name), stack: the item id, count, energy (ContainerType.ENERGY.getOrZero), patch (component patch keys), has_component, bar_visible/bar_width/bar_color (ItemStack), ratio, tooltip (the tooltip lines, normal flag, encoded as text components) or tooltip_error, encoded (the stack's codec JSON). The gear config values: tabletMaxEnergy and the others, as the config holds them.
